doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Road life and the Basie band's 'bat club'
summary: Heard declines to explain the band's bat club initiation, pointing to Al Grey and Buddy Tate.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Did you do significant traveling with them?
Tell us about some of the times on the road with that band.
I can’t put anybody’s, lies, if you hear anything it’s all lies anyway, but, I had a wonderful time with that band. Did they tell you about the bat club? Al Grey?
We heard about a court system they had.
Oh Al Grey told you, oh good.
But the bat system was a little different. Do you want to tell us about that?
Well that’s how you wound up in court. No I won’t go into that. I just thought I’d leave that hanging. See that’s a little bit of suspense.
Well ladies and gentlemen, if you ever run into John Heard, you’ve got to ask—
Yeah, call Buddy Tate back in. He knows it. Those were the elders in the band, see. When I was in the band I was just a youngster so I can’t do that.
Well Al told us quite a story about when he was the new guy and they really, you know, gave him some initiation. Was that the same with you?
